scope: Exactly the43 remaining academic work items; 18 corpus repositories plus the master. Egyptian and unrelated projects excluded.
method: Current Git main snapshots fetched for19 repositories; original observations resolved against current committed evidence. Additional bounded source discovery/consultation and executable Milyan union are reported separately. This is not independent re-collation of all readings or adjudication by43 specialists.
